entities.summary: Curt "Curre" Lundmark is a Swedish former ice hockey player and manager. As head coach, he led the Swedish men's national team to a gold medal during the 1994 Olympic Winter Games in Lillehammer. Earlier, he had also assisted Conny Evensson when Sweden won the 1991 IIHF World Championship in Turku and the 1992 IIHF World Championship in Prague. Led by Curt Lundmark, the Swedes also won a silver medal during the 1995 IIHF World Championship in Stockholm, losing the final game to Finland (1-4). Curt Lundmark resigned after that tournament, and was replaced by Kent Forsberg.
